in_marathi.name: Gourinath
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Gouri
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gourinath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gourinath is the name of Lord Shiva, who is also known as the Lord of Gouri, or Goddess Parvati. This name is derived from the combination of two words: ‘Gouri’ (Goddess Parvati) and ‘Nath’ (Lord or Master). It signifies the divine union of Shiva and Parvati.

This name is derived from the combination of two words: ‘Gouri’ (Goddess Parvati) and ‘Nath’ (Lord or Master). It signifies the divine union of Shiva and Parvati.
